reviews.quote: Workstations have bad battery life? Think again! — extremely good build quality, Thunderbolt 5, modular LPCAMM2 RAM, up to 22h battery, and one of the best keyboards among current ThinkPads.

praises: Thin-and-light 16" workstation weight (~1.76 kg) — P1-class portability with ISV-certified pro graphics
Best-in-class ThinkPad keyboard with TrackPoint on a 16" pro machine
Panther Lake Arc Pro handles CAD viewport work quietly for a thin chassis; vPro manageability for business fleets
Deep Black Friday discount ($6,399 → $3,589) makes P1-class build accessible
Premium magnesium/carbon lid build with MIL-STD durability testing
complaints: Soldered RAM — 32GB cannot be upgraded, unusual limitation for a workstation line
Thin chassis throttles sustained CPU/GPU load vs thicker P16
Base 60Hz IPS panel at this price tier is mediocre for color-critical creator work
Lenovo/retail regular prices are heavily inflated anchor pricing; only sale price is real
No verified Canadian review coverage of Gen 9 — early-buyer risk on drivers for the new Arc Pro stack

design_philosophy: The P1 is the thin premium mobile workstation — the successor to the X1 Extreme line — packing ISV-certified pro graphics into a ~1.76 kg 16" chassis for engineers and creators who travel. This Gen 9 config trades discrete GPU muscle for the integrated Arc Pro tier: maximum portability and battery at the workstation tier, at the cost of heavy 3D throughput.
